What this record is for, what belongs in it, and what stays out.

State the intention here: whose life this remembers, and the scope judgments to
apply when deciding whether a fact belongs. Two questions decide most of it —
would this still matter in two weeks, and does it have a home already? A fact
that fails the first belongs in a daily note; a fact that fails the second is a
bullet on a page that exists, not a page of its own.

This page is loaded at every session start and configures nothing: the
constitution (`config/constitution.json`) is the settings surface.
